content:
ivan: Hey team, handing off primary in ~10m. Priya, you good to take primary for the 21:00-01:00 UTC window? I'm going to run through access checks now. :wave:
priya: I can take primary. quick note — my PagerDuty mobile is installed but I lost Grafana SSO last week, not sure if the token is still valid. Also confirmation I have the prod assume-role? @sam can you confirm? :eyes:
sam: @priya I just looked — you're in the PD schedule and in the escalation policy (level 1). Grafana membership shows you in the Observability team but not the prod-org role; infra needs to add the prod dashboard viewer role. I'll page infra now.
infra-bot: Incident helper: new request created #INC-4492 to grant grafana role to priya. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/INC-4492
ivan: Before we swap, run these quick checks (copy/paste):
```bash
# PagerDuty: confirm you can see primary incidents
open https://redwood.pagerduty.com/schedules
# Grafana health check (use your API key env var if needed)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_API_KEY" https://grafana.redwood.internal/api/health | jq .
# AWS: try assume role and list the oncall tagging bucket
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-prod-oncall --role-session-name oncall-test
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-prod-oncall-logs --no-sign-request
```
priya: Ran the PD schedule link — I can see the rotation. Grafana curl returns 401 for me. AWS assume-role succeeded but listing the S3 bucket returned AccessDenied. So partial access only.
will: Coverage note — I'm covering secondary from 23:00-01:00 but I have a 30m meeting at 00:15. If an incident coincides with that meeting, Sam will be backup. We should call out that 00:15-00:45 has a coverage gap for deep infra troubleshooting unless Sam picks up.
sam: I can be backup for that window. I'll remain reachable. Adding a PD note to the escalation so that if primary doesn't ack in 2min, secondary gets pager.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: New page policy update applied to "prod-inference" escalation — 2min -> escalate to secondary.
ivan: Good. infra-bot — can you fast-track Grafana role for priya? We need at least read access to the prod dashboards (latency/cost/errors) for triage.
infra-bot: Grant request queued, ticket INC-4492. ETA ~18 minutes for role grant (requires IAM approval). Will post once done.
ivan: While we wait, Priya, memorize these runbook pointers for common pages:
- prod-routing-500s: check model pool saturation -> metrics: /dashboards/model-pools -> if >85% utilization, evict small-request batching, enable fallback to quantized variant.
- prefix-cache-miss: check KV cache hit rate -> /dashboards/cache -> if hit_rate < 60% restart kvproxy -> `sudo systemctl restart kvproxy` on oncall-host-01.
- slow-token-generation: check redis latency and worker queue depth -> if redis >200ms or queue>1000, escalate to infra and flip to read-only mode in the console.
priya: Got it. If I get a page and can't access Grafana, I'll ask for screenshots in PD and request a short audit from infra. If AWS S3 denies, I'll escalate to infra immediately (s3 access is needed for crash logs).
ivan: Also remember ability to trigger fallback model is in Console -> Model controls -> select "fallback-embed-quant" -> Deploy (no infra touch). If deployment fails, call infra immediately.
sam: Added a note to the runbook: `if PD ack latency > 30s, call the oncall group chat and @will` — just in case mobile PD fails.
will: thumbs up. One more thing: if you need to spin up a hot node, use the dedicated pool toggle in the console and set instance type g5.8x large; that avoids queuing on shared capacity. Runbook has exact CLI commands under the "capacity ops" section.
ivan: I'm handing over now — Priya is primary, Will secondary until 23:00 then Sam becomes secondary. If anything blocks access (Grafana/AWS/PD) post the PD incident and ping infra in #eng-infra AND here. I will monitor for 10m and then sign off. :thumbsup:
priya: Taking over. Logging into PD now and marking notes. Will keep this thread updated if any access changes happen.
ivan: Thanks — handing off. :white_check_mark:
